title: A generator that throws is not finished, and its `finally` runs twice.
text: After a throw from a generator's body is caught, the next `advance()` on the same generator runs the body again from its last `yield` and throws again; a second `foreach` over it does the same. A throw that leaves a `try … finally` around a `yield` runs the `finally` when the throw passes through it, and a second time when the generator is freed: `1[closed][closed]caught`. A generator whose body throws is finished, so a later `advance()` returns `false`, and its `finally` runs once. It closes when that is so, with a conformance case for each.
